nuggets.text: Beavers coach JaMarcus Shephard played receiver at Division III DePauw and set its career kickoff return yardage record.

The 1967 Beavers earned the nickname Giant Killers after upsetting No. 3 USC.
Benny Beaver wields a fake chainsaw, and an ear-splitting chainsaw sound plays at Reser Stadium when opponents near third down.
Toy chainsaws are on the approved-items list at Reser Stadium, so Beavers fans often bring their own.
The Beavers and Washington State were the only two schools left in the Pac-12 before it was rebuilt for 2026.
The Beavers' first game, in 1893, was a 64-0 win over Albany College, with fans paying ten cents to get in.
